snippet.title: Parisian Bistro Simulator - 1.0 Trailer
snippet.description:
🎉 Parisian Bistro Simulator 1.0 Coming September 18, 2026

Parisian Bistro Simulator is reaching its biggest milestone yet with the 1.0 release, bringing a completely redesigned bistro, deeper management systems, new gameplay mechanics, and much more.

🎮 New in 1.0:
• A Brand-New Bistro
• Daily Menu System
• Deeper Employee Management
• Expanded Finance & Dirty Money Systems
• Casino Activities
• New Kitchen Mini-Games
• And much more to discover on September 18

👥 Play solo or with up to 8 players in co-op.

👉 Play now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3058360/Parisian_Bistro_Simulator/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=update_100
